title: Each of the five launch funnels has a live door with one promise, one button and its own UTM

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 5 of the launch brief (ADR-1720). The five funnels are Calm down fast, Find your people, Host one Circle, Bring your practice and Run it together. TODAY: the /for/* pages (app/for/[niche]/page.tsx, lib/marketing/funnel-config.ts:226-595) are five paid-plan conversion pages for businesses, not these doors. /calm-down-fast is an SEO article whose button goes to /on-air, which sends a signed-out visitor to /sign-in (proxy.ts:61). /start has three doors that all land on /join. No door lands on this week's Events near you, a Starter Circle to Remix (circle_templates_enabled flag), a free Space with one service or Event, or a Business Space with a Collaborator. THE FIX: one registry, lib/marketing/launch-doors.ts, holding each door's slug, promise, button and utm_campaign, and a public page per door that renders from it. Each button lands on the funnel's first win. UTM capture already exists (fq_attr cookie, lib/attribution/first-touch.ts) so each door only needs its own campaign. /for/teachers and the "Who is Frequency for?" answer belong to the demographic rollout (its PR 8, LIVE-790 series), not this row. Calm down fast lands on the public timer once LIVE-805 ships; until then it lands on the closest signed-out practice. Member-facing: needs a help line and a changelog entry.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-800";const s=r("lib/marketing/launch-doors.ts");if(!s)fail(ID+": no launch door registry (lib/marketing/launch-doors.ts)");const want=["calm-down-fast","find-your-people","host-one-circle","bring-your-practice","run-it-together"];const miss=want.filter(w=>!s.includes(w));if(miss.length)fail(ID+": doors missing from the registry: "+miss.join(", "));if((s.match(/utmCampaign/g)||[]).length<5)fail(ID+": every door needs its own utmCampaign");const pages=walk("app").filter(f=>/page\.tsx$/.test(f)&&!f.includes("(main)")&&/launch-doors/.test(r(f)));if(!pages.length)fail(ID+": no public page renders the doors")'
verify.note: Fails while the five doors have no registry with their own UTM campaign and no public page renders them.
